name: THE VOID — Foundation & Infrastructure
objective: Establish the core rendering, physics, and build infrastructure for the entire spatial-anubis project. Three.js + Rapier + SparkJS integrated at 60fps.

tasks.title: Initialize Bun project with TypeScript and package.json
tasks.deliverable: Bun-managed project with TypeScript, package.json with all core dependencies declared.
tasks.acceptance: bun install succeeds; tsc --noEmit passes on empty src/.

tasks.title: Configure Vite with React, TypeScript, and HMR
tasks.deliverable: Vite config with React plugin, TypeScript support, and hot module replacement enabled.
tasks.acceptance: bun run dev starts Vite dev server; editing a .tsx file triggers HMR without full reload.

tasks.title: Set up React 18 with strict mode entry point
tasks.deliverable: React 18 app root rendered inside StrictMode with a blank page at localhost.
tasks.acceptance: Browser loads localhost and renders an empty React root without console errors.

tasks.title: Install and configure ESLint with TypeScript rules
tasks.deliverable: ESLint config with TypeScript-ESLint plugin, React hooks rules, and import ordering.
tasks.acceptance: bun run lint exits 0 on clean src/ and catches a deliberately introduced type error.

tasks.title: Install and configure Prettier with consistent formatting
tasks.deliverable: Prettier config with single quotes, trailing commas, 100-char line width, and ESLint integration.
tasks.acceptance: bun run format --check exits 0 on all source files.

tasks.title: Configure TypeScript strict mode (strict, strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny)
tasks.deliverable: tsconfig.json with strict, strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled.
tasks.acceptance: tsc --noEmit passes; a file with implicit any causes tsc to fail.

tasks.title: Initialize Git repository with .gitignore for node_modules, dist, .env
tasks.deliverable: Git repository with initial commit and .gitignore covering node_modules, dist, .env, and OS files.
tasks.acceptance: git status shows clean working tree; node_modules and dist are not tracked.

tasks.title: Create folder structure: src/{core,physics,rendering,vessel,engines,rituals,onboarding,audio,bio,shaders,state,utils}
tasks.deliverable: Directory tree with index.ts barrel files in each module directory.
tasks.acceptance: All 12 directories exist under src/ with index.ts files; tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: Set up environment variables system (.env.development, .env.production, .env.staging)
tasks.deliverable: Three .env files with typed VITE_ prefixed variables and a src/utils/env.ts accessor.
tasks.acceptance: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL resolves correctly per environment; missing vars throw at build time.

tasks.title: Install React-Three-Fiber and create base Canvas component with PerspectiveCamera
tasks.deliverable: R3F Canvas component with PerspectiveCamera (fov 60, near 0.1, far 1000) rendering a black scene.
tasks.acceptance: Browser shows a WebGL canvas filling the viewport; React DevTools show Canvas and Camera nodes.

tasks.title: Implement Deep Ink (#1A1A2E) skybox as scene background
tasks.deliverable: Scene background set to Deep Ink color via Three.js scene.background.
tasks.acceptance: Canvas background is visually #1A1A2E; color picker confirms the hex value.

tasks.title: Set up Three.js lighting: Ambient (Deep Ink, low intensity), Key (Bone #F5F0E8, high above), Rim (Gold #B8860B, edge highlighting)
tasks.deliverable: Three-light rig with AmbientLight, DirectionalLight (key), and PointLight (rim) with brand colors.
tasks.acceptance: A test sphere shows ambient fill, directional key shadow, and gold rim highlight.

tasks.title: Install Rapier.js WASM module and initialize physics world
tasks.deliverable: Rapier WASM initialized asynchronously with a physics World instance at default gravity (0, -9.81, 0).
tasks.acceptance: Console logs confirm Rapier version; world.step() executes without errors.

tasks.title: Implement fixed-timestep physics loop at 1/60s with accumulator pattern
tasks.deliverable: Fixed-timestep loop decoupled from render frame rate using time accumulator and substep capping.
tasks.acceptance: Physics steps execute at exactly 60Hz regardless of render FPS; accumulator never exceeds 3 substeps.

tasks.title: Build useFrame interpolation system for smooth rendering between physics steps
tasks.deliverable: Interpolation hook that lerps Three.js object transforms between current and previous physics states.
tasks.acceptance: Moving physics bodies appear smooth at 144Hz display; no visible stutter or teleporting.

tasks.title: Define 5 collision layers as bitmasks: VESSEL(0x01), RITUAL(0x02), ATMOSPHERE(0x04), WORLD(0x08), TARGET(0x10)
tasks.deliverable: Typed CollisionLayer enum and helper functions for bitmask operations (combine, check, toggle).
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests verify all 5 layers are distinct bitmasks; combine(VESSEL, RITUAL) produces 0x03.

tasks.title: Implement collision layer interaction matrix (VESSEL<->RITUAL, VESSEL<->ATMOSPHERE, RITUAL<->TARGET, etc.)
tasks.deliverable: Collision group and filter mask configuration applied to all RigidBody constructors.
tasks.acceptance: VESSEL collides with RITUAL but not with ATMOSPHERE; interaction matrix matches spec exactly.

tasks.title: Create gravity zone system with 4 directional zones: North(0,-3.27,0), East(0,-9.81,0), West(0,-14.72,0), South(0,-4.91,0)
tasks.deliverable: GravityZone system with 4 named zones each having distinct gravity vectors applied to the physics world.
tasks.acceptance: A test body dropped in each zone falls at the zone-specific acceleration rate.

tasks.title: Implement gravity interpolation for zone transitions (linear interpolation over 2 seconds)
tasks.deliverable: Gravity vector lerp system that smoothly transitions between zone gravities over 2000ms.
tasks.acceptance: Crossing from North to East zone shows gravity smoothly change from 3.27 to 9.81 over 2 seconds.

tasks.title: Create floor plane with static RigidBody and Collider on WORLD layer
tasks.deliverable: Static floor plane at y=0 with cuboid collider on WORLD collision layer.
tasks.acceptance: Dynamic bodies rest on the floor plane; they do not fall through it.

tasks.title: Spawn test physics cube (Dynamic RigidBody) for gravity/collision validation
tasks.deliverable: 1-unit dynamic cube that spawns at (0, 5, 0) and falls under gravity to the floor plane.
tasks.acceptance: Cube falls, bounces on floor, and comes to rest; physics debug shows correct collision events.

tasks.title: Set up post-processing stack skeleton with EffectComposer: Bloom, Grain, Vignette, ChromaticAberration
tasks.deliverable: EffectComposer pipeline with four effect passes wired in correct order.
tasks.acceptance: All four effects render without errors; toggling each effect on/off changes visual output.

tasks.title: Configure Bloom with selective threshold (0.8) targeting Gold and bioluminescent materials
tasks.deliverable: Bloom pass with luminance threshold 0.8, radius 0.4, and intensity tuned for Gold material glow.
tasks.acceptance: Gold-colored objects emit visible bloom glow; dark objects produce no bloom artifacts.

tasks.title: Configure Film Grain at opacity 0.05 for analog texture
tasks.deliverable: Film grain post-processing pass with 0.05 opacity and animated noise pattern.
tasks.acceptance: Grain is subtly visible on a static scene; opacity slider confirms 0.05 baseline.

tasks.title: Configure heavy Vignette for center-focused composition
tasks.deliverable: Vignette post-processing pass with strong edge darkening and smooth falloff curve.
tasks.acceptance: Screen edges are noticeably darker than center; effect is visible in a screenshot comparison.

tasks.title: Configure ChromaticAberration with baseline 0.0 and entropy-responsive range to 0.5
tasks.deliverable: ChromaticAberration pass with configurable offset driven by an entropy uniform (0.0 to 0.5).
tasks.acceptance: Setting entropy to 0.0 shows no aberration; setting to 0.5 shows visible RGB fringing at edges.

tasks.title: Install Vitest and create test configuration for unit testing
tasks.deliverable: Vitest config with TypeScript support, path aliases, and a passing example test.
tasks.acceptance: bun run test executes Vitest; the example test passes; coverage report generates.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI pipeline: lint, typecheck, test on push
tasks.deliverable: GitHub Actions workflow running lint, tsc --noEmit, and vitest on every push and PR.
tasks.acceptance: A push triggers CI; all three steps pass green; a deliberate lint error causes CI failure.

tasks.title: Build FPS counter component with rolling 60-frame average display
tasks.deliverable: React component displaying rolling average FPS over the last 60 frames in a fixed overlay.
tasks.acceptance: FPS counter updates every frame; value stabilizes near 60 on a capable machine.

tasks.title: Build physics timing monitor (measure Rapier step duration per frame)
tasks.deliverable: Performance.now()-based timer around world.step() reporting milliseconds per physics tick.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay shows physics step time in ms; value stays under 2ms with a single cube.

tasks.title: Create memory profiling hooks (track heap usage, geometry count, texture memory)
tasks.deliverable: Custom hooks reading performance.memory, renderer.info.memory, and renderer.info.render stats.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay displays heap MB, geometry count, and texture count; values update every second.

tasks.title: Implement React error boundary components wrapping Canvas and physics
tasks.deliverable: Error boundary components that catch render errors and display a fallback UI with error details.
tasks.acceptance: A deliberately thrown error in a child component shows the fallback UI instead of a white screen.

tasks.title: Create README.md with architecture overview, tech stack, and setup instructions
tasks.deliverable: README.md with project description, tech stack table, setup steps, and folder structure diagram.
tasks.acceptance: README renders correctly on GitHub; setup instructions produce a running dev server when followed.

tasks.title: Build OrbitControls placeholder for development navigation
tasks.deliverable: OrbitControls from drei with damping, zoom limits, and dev-only conditional rendering.
tasks.acceptance: Mouse drag rotates camera; scroll zooms; controls are disabled when NODE_ENV is production.

tasks.title: Create Three.js material library: DeepInkMaterial, BoneMaterial, GoldMaterial, TerraMaterial
tasks.deliverable: Four MeshStandardMaterial instances with brand colors, roughness, and metalness presets.
tasks.acceptance: A test scene with four spheres shows visually distinct Deep Ink, Bone, Gold, and Terra materials.

tasks.title: Build scene traversal profiler (count nodes, geometries, materials per frame in debug overlay)
tasks.deliverable: Profiler that traverses the scene graph and reports object counts in the debug overlay.
tasks.acceptance: Adding objects to the scene increases the reported node count in real time.

tasks.title: Create typed Vector3 utility wrapping Three.js Vector3 with Rapier vector compatibility
tasks.deliverable: SpatialVector3 class with toThree() and toRapier() conversion methods and arithmetic operators.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests pass for add, scale, lerp, toThree, and toRapier conversions.

tasks.title: Set up Playwright for end-to-end browser testing with Chrome, Firefox, WebKit
tasks.deliverable: Playwright config with three browser projects and a smoke test that loads the app.
tasks.acceptance: bun run test:e2e runs the smoke test in all three browsers; all pass.

tasks.title: Create API client abstraction with typed fetch wrapper, error handling, retry logic
tasks.deliverable: Typed API client with generic fetch<T>(), automatic retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff), and error types.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests verify successful fetch, retry on 500, and typed error on 404.

tasks.title: Implement requestAnimationFrame game loop with pause/resume on tab visibility
tasks.deliverable: Game loop using rAF that pauses physics and rendering when document.hidden is true.
tasks.acceptance: Switching tabs pauses the FPS counter; returning resumes without physics explosion or time jump.

tasks.title: Build initial load performance test (measure time from page load to first physics frame)
tasks.deliverable: Playwright test that measures performance.mark() timings from navigation start to first physics step.
tasks.acceptance: Test reports load time in ms; value is under 5000ms on CI hardware.

tasks.title: Configure TypeScript path aliases (@core, @physics, @rendering, @vessel, @engines, etc.)
tasks.deliverable: tsconfig paths and Vite resolve.alias mapping all 12 module directories to @ prefixed imports.
tasks.acceptance: import { X } from '@physics/index' resolves correctly; tsc and Vite both resolve the aliases.

tasks.title: Install SparkJS and integrate into Three.js render loop
tasks.deliverable: SparkJS renderer initialized and composited into the R3F render loop on each frame.
tasks.acceptance: SparkJS renders splats alongside Three.js meshes in the same canvas without flicker.

tasks.title: Validate shared WebGL context between SparkJS and R3F (single canvas)
tasks.deliverable: Validation test confirming both renderers share one WebGL2 context without state corruption.
tasks.acceptance: gl.getParameter(gl.VERSION) returns same context ID for both renderers; no WebGL errors in console.

tasks.title: Load and render a static .splat file in the scene
tasks.deliverable: A test .splat file loaded from local assets and rendered visibly in the scene.
tasks.acceptance: Splat object is visible in the viewport; no loading errors in console.

tasks.title: Implement splat streaming system with progressive quality loading
tasks.deliverable: Progressive splat loader that streams low-quality first, then refines to full quality over time.
tasks.acceptance: Splat appears within 500ms at low quality; full quality loads within 3 seconds on broadband.

tasks.title: Build performance governor: monitor frame time, adjust splat quality dynamically
tasks.deliverable: Adaptive quality system that reduces splat count when frame time exceeds 16.67ms target.
tasks.acceptance: Artificially loading 500K splats triggers governor to reduce count until FPS returns above 55.

tasks.title: Configure Static splat pool: 300,000 splats for world geometry
tasks.deliverable: Pre-allocated splat buffer pool of 300K splats designated for static world geometry.
tasks.acceptance: Pool allocates 300K splats; attempting to exceed pool size triggers warning, not crash.

tasks.title: Configure Dynamic splat pool: 150,000 splats for vessel and interactive objects
tasks.deliverable: Pre-allocated splat buffer pool of 150K splats designated for dynamic interactive objects.
tasks.acceptance: Pool allocates 150K splats; pool usage counter accurately tracks active splat count.

tasks.title: Configure Effect splat pool: 50,000 splats for particles and VFX
tasks.deliverable: Pre-allocated splat buffer pool of 50K splats designated for particle effects and VFX.
tasks.acceptance: Pool allocates 50K splats; splats can be rapidly allocated and freed without memory leak.

tasks.title: Implement frustum culling for Gaussian splats based on camera view
tasks.deliverable: Frustum culling system that skips rendering splats outside the camera view frustum.
tasks.acceptance: Rotating camera away from splats reduces GPU draw calls; profiler confirms culled splat count.

tasks.title: Implement distance-based splat culling (fade out beyond 50 units)
tasks.deliverable: Distance culling that fades splat opacity to zero between 40-50 units from camera.
tasks.acceptance: Splats at 30 units are fully opaque; at 45 units partially transparent; at 50+ units invisible.

tasks.title: Build LOD system skeleton with 4 tiers: Full (0-5u), Medium (5-15u), Low (15-30u), Icon (30u+)
tasks.deliverable: LOD manager that assigns quality tiers to splat groups based on camera distance.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay shows LOD tier per object; moving camera changes tier assignments correctly.

tasks.title: Implement IndexedDB caching layer for downloaded splat assets
tasks.deliverable: IndexedDB cache with versioned keys, TTL expiry, and size quota management for splat files.
tasks.acceptance: Second load of a splat file reads from IndexedDB with zero network requests; cache hit logged.

tasks.title: Configure CDN endpoint for static asset delivery (splats, textures, WASM)
tasks.deliverable: CDN configuration with cache headers, CORS, and WASM MIME types for static asset serving.
tasks.acceptance: Fetching a test asset from CDN URL returns 200 with correct Content-Type and cache headers.

tasks.title: Define spatial coordinate system: North(0,0,-50), East(50,0,0), West(-50,0,0), South(0,0,50), Center(0,0,0)
tasks.deliverable: Typed ZoneCoordinate constants and helper functions for zone center lookup and nearest-zone calculation.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests verify all 5 zone centers match spec; nearestZone((25,0,-25)) returns North or East.

tasks.title: Create zone boundary colliders as 10-unit gradient sensor fields between zones
tasks.deliverable: Sensor colliders at zone boundaries that detect entry/exit without blocking physics bodies.
tasks.acceptance: Moving a body across a boundary triggers onSensorEnter and onSensorExit events.

tasks.title: Implement zone transition interpolation: gravity vector lerp over 2 seconds
tasks.deliverable: Gravity transition system triggered by zone boundary sensors with 2-second lerp duration.
tasks.acceptance: Crossing East-to-North boundary shows gravity smoothly changing from 9.81 to 3.27 over 2 seconds.

tasks.title: Implement zone transition interpolation: fog density exponential ease-in-out over 2 seconds
tasks.deliverable: Fog density interpolation using exponential ease-in-out curve during zone transitions.
tasks.acceptance: Zone transition shows fog density smoothly changing without abrupt pops or visible seams.

tasks.title: Implement zone transition interpolation: fog color HSL interpolation over 1.5 seconds
tasks.deliverable: Fog color transition using HSL space interpolation to avoid muddy intermediate colors.
tasks.acceptance: Transitioning between two zone fog colors produces a visually smooth hue shift without gray midpoints.

tasks.title: Build fog system with per-zone density and color configuration
tasks.deliverable: Configurable fog system with per-zone fog color, near distance, far distance, and density.
tasks.acceptance: Each zone displays distinct fog settings; debug overlay shows current fog parameters.

tasks.title: Create Gaussian atmosphere breathfield scaffold (placeholder for bio-driven splats in North zone)
tasks.deliverable: Placeholder breathfield component in North zone with oscillating splat opacity driven by a sine wave.
tasks.acceptance: North zone shows pulsing splat cloud at 0.25Hz frequency; amplitude responds to a test input value.

tasks.title: Build asset loading manager with progress callbacks and parallel download support
tasks.deliverable: Asset manager with typed load<T>(), progress events, parallel queue (max 4 concurrent), and cancellation.
tasks.acceptance: Loading 8 assets shows 4 concurrent downloads; progress callback fires with correct percentage.

tasks.title: Implement KTX2 texture compression pipeline for efficient GPU upload
tasks.deliverable: KTX2 texture loader with basis transcoder for GPU-compressed texture upload.
tasks.acceptance: KTX2 texture loads and displays correctly; GPU memory usage is lower than equivalent PNG.

tasks.title: Optimize WASM module loading (parallel fetch of Rapier + MediaPipe binaries)
tasks.deliverable: Parallel WASM loader using Promise.all for Rapier and MediaPipe initialization.
tasks.acceptance: Both WASM modules initialize in parallel; total load time is less than the sum of individual loads.

tasks.title: Build Web Worker manager skeleton for offloading MediaPipe, audio processing
tasks.deliverable: Worker pool manager with typed message passing, error handling, and automatic worker recycling.
tasks.acceptance: A test computation runs in a worker and returns results via postMessage without blocking main thread.

tasks.title: Create shader uniform system: typed uniform bindings for PIP data, time, camera, zone
tasks.deliverable: Typed uniform manager that updates shared uniforms (time, camera position, zone ID, PIP values) per frame.
tasks.acceptance: Custom shader reads u_time and u_cameraPosition uniforms; values update every frame correctly.

tasks.title: Build R3F component library: BaseScene, PhysicsWorld, SplatRenderer, ZoneManager
tasks.deliverable: Four composable R3F components encapsulating scene setup, physics, splat rendering, and zone logic.
tasks.acceptance: Composing all four components produces a working scene with physics, splats, and zone detection.

tasks.title: Set up Zustand store with slices: world, vessel, physics, bio, engines, session, debug
tasks.deliverable: Zustand store with 7 typed slices, selectors, and devtools middleware integration.
tasks.acceptance: Each slice is independently accessible; Zustand devtools show all 7 slices with correct initial state.

tasks.title: Define session state schema: world_id, archetype_seed, biome_config, physics_config, zones
tasks.deliverable: TypeScript interfaces for SessionState with all fields, defaults, and Zod validation schema.
tasks.acceptance: Zod parse succeeds on valid session data; parse fails with descriptive error on invalid data.

tasks.title: Build debug overlay component: FPS, physics ms, splat count, memory MB, zone name
tasks.deliverable: Unified debug overlay panel displaying all performance metrics in a semi-transparent HUD.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay shows all 5 metrics updating in real-time; toggle with backtick key hides/shows it.

tasks.title: Implement render order management for transparent splat layers (z-sorting)
tasks.deliverable: Z-sorting system for transparent splat layers ensuring correct back-to-front rendering order.
tasks.acceptance: Overlapping transparent splats render without z-fighting artifacts from multiple viewing angles.

tasks.title: Build Three.js object pool for frequently created/destroyed meshes
tasks.deliverable: Generic object pool with acquire/release API, pre-warming, and automatic cleanup on pool resize.
tasks.acceptance: Acquiring and releasing 1000 meshes causes zero GC pauses; pool reuses existing instances.

tasks.title: Create frame time histogram visualization (rolling 120-frame distribution in debug)
tasks.deliverable: Canvas-based histogram showing frame time distribution over the last 120 frames in debug overlay.
tasks.acceptance: Histogram shows a bell curve around 16.67ms at 60fps; spikes are visually identifiable.

tasks.title: Implement dev mode URL parameter system (?debug=true&zone=east&skip-descent=true)
tasks.deliverable: URL parameter parser that reads dev flags and injects them into the Zustand debug slice.
tasks.acceptance: Loading with ?debug=true enables debug overlay; ?zone=east starts camera in East zone.

tasks.title: Build Rapier debug wireframe renderer (toggleable collision shape visualization)
tasks.deliverable: Wireframe renderer that draws all Rapier collision shapes as semi-transparent colored outlines.
tasks.acceptance: Toggling debug physics shows wireframe colliders; shapes match actual collision boundaries.

tasks.title: Create shared GLSL includes: noise.glsl, brandColors.glsl, math.glsl via #include system
tasks.deliverable: GLSL include preprocessor with noise functions, brand color constants, and math utilities.
tasks.acceptance: A test shader using #include noise.glsl compiles and produces correct Perlin noise output.

tasks.title: Build load waterfall optimization (parallel WASM + core asset fetching, target <3s init)
tasks.deliverable: Optimized load sequence that parallelizes WASM, fonts, and core assets with a waterfall diagram.
tasks.acceptance: Performance timeline shows parallel fetching; total initialization completes under 3 seconds on 4G.

tasks.title: Create production Vite config with source maps, asset hashing, minification
tasks.deliverable: Production Vite config with terser minification, content-hash filenames, and external source maps.
tasks.acceptance: bun run build produces hashed assets under 2MB total; source maps are generated but not included in dist.

tasks.title: Build zone label debug overlay (current zone name + gravity vector display)
tasks.deliverable: Debug overlay element showing current zone name and gravity vector as formatted text.
tasks.acceptance: Moving between zones updates the displayed zone name and gravity vector in real time.

tasks.title: Implement WASM binary size CI monitor (fail if Rapier + MediaPipe > 6MB total)
tasks.deliverable: CI step that measures combined WASM binary size and fails the build if it exceeds 6MB.
tasks.acceptance: CI passes when WASM is under 6MB; adding a dummy 5MB WASM file causes CI failure.

tasks.title: Enforce TypeScript strictNullChecks across all modules (no @ts-ignore)
tasks.deliverable: All source files pass tsc with strictNullChecks; ESLint rule bans @ts-ignore comments.
tasks.acceptance: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors; grep for @ts-ignore returns zero results.

tasks.title: Build degradation tier system skeleton: Tier 0 (full), Tier 1 (-splats), Tier 2 (-post), Tier 3 (minimum)
tasks.deliverable: Degradation manager with 4 tiers that progressively disables features to maintain 60fps.
tasks.acceptance: Forcing Tier 3 disables splats and post-processing; FPS remains above 55 on low-end GPU.

tasks.title: Create fallback detection system (WebGL2 support, WASM support, webcam availability)
tasks.deliverable: Capability detection module that checks WebGL2, WASM, and getUserMedia availability at startup.
tasks.acceptance: Missing WebGL2 shows a styled fallback page; all capabilities report correctly on supported browsers.

tasks.title: Build ambient audio system skeleton with Web Audio API AudioContext and GainNode
tasks.deliverable: AudioContext initialized on first user interaction with master GainNode and mute toggle.
tasks.acceptance: A test oscillator plays through the audio system; mute toggle silences and restores audio.

tasks.title: Create zone-specific audio configuration (frequency, reverb, volume per zone)
tasks.deliverable: Audio config map with per-zone base frequency, reverb parameters, and volume levels.
tasks.acceptance: Switching zones via debug command changes audio parameters to match zone configuration.

tasks.title: Implement audio crossfade system for zone transitions (3-second crossfade)
tasks.deliverable: Audio crossfade that blends outgoing and incoming zone audio over 3 seconds during transitions.
tasks.acceptance: Zone transition produces smooth audio blend with no clicks, pops, or silence gaps.

tasks.title: Build localStorage persistence layer for user preferences and session data
tasks.deliverable: Typed localStorage wrapper with JSON serialization, versioned keys, and quota error handling.
tasks.acceptance: Saving and loading preferences roundtrips correctly; quota exceeded triggers graceful fallback.

tasks.title: Create application state hydration system (restore state from localStorage on reload)
tasks.deliverable: State hydration that reads persisted session data from localStorage into Zustand on app mount.
tasks.acceptance: Setting a preference, reloading the page, and checking the store shows the persisted value.

tasks.title: Implement window resize handler with canvas and camera aspect ratio updates
tasks.deliverable: Resize observer that updates canvas dimensions and camera aspect ratio on window resize.
tasks.acceptance: Resizing the browser window maintains correct aspect ratio; no stretching or black bars appear.

tasks.title: Build pixel ratio detection and capping (max DPR 2.0 for performance)
tasks.deliverable: DPR detection that caps renderer pixel ratio at 2.0 regardless of display devicePixelRatio.
tasks.acceptance: On a 3x DPR display, renderer.getPixelRatio() returns 2.0; render resolution is capped.

tasks.title: Create global error handler with stack trace capture and state snapshot
tasks.deliverable: Global error and unhandledrejection handlers that capture stack traces and Zustand state snapshots.
tasks.acceptance: A deliberately thrown error is caught; error log includes stack trace and current store state.

tasks.title: Build development hot-reload preservation (maintain physics state across HMR)
tasks.deliverable: Vite HMR handler that preserves physics world state and body positions during module replacement.
tasks.acceptance: Editing a component file triggers HMR; physics bodies remain in their current positions post-reload.

tasks.title: Implement Three.js dispose utility (clean up geometries, materials, textures on unmount)
tasks.deliverable: Recursive dispose function that traverses scene graph and releases all GPU resources on unmount.
tasks.acceptance: Mounting and unmounting a scene 100 times shows stable memory usage with no GPU memory leak.

tasks.title: Create typed event bus for decoupled system communication (physics->render, bio->shader)
tasks.deliverable: Typed EventEmitter with generic event map, subscribe/unsubscribe, and automatic cleanup on unmount.
tasks.acceptance: Emitting a typed event triggers all subscribers; unsubscribing prevents further callbacks.

tasks.title: Build scene graph optimization (merge static geometries, instance repeated objects)
tasks.deliverable: Scene optimizer that merges static BufferGeometries and creates InstancedMesh for repeated objects.
tasks.acceptance: A scene with 100 identical cubes uses 1 draw call via instancing instead of 100 draw calls.

tasks.title: Implement render target management for post-processing pipeline
tasks.deliverable: Render target pool that allocates and reuses WebGLRenderTargets for multi-pass post-processing.
tasks.acceptance: Post-processing uses pooled render targets; no new targets are allocated after initial setup.

tasks.title: Create comprehensive P0 integration test: cube falls with gravity at 60fps, splats render
tasks.deliverable: Playwright integration test verifying physics simulation and splat rendering run together at target FPS.
tasks.acceptance: Test passes: cube falls to floor, splats are visible, and average FPS is above 55 over 5 seconds.

tasks.title: Build CI performance gate: fail if integration test drops below 55fps
tasks.deliverable: CI step that runs the P0 integration test and fails the build if average FPS drops below 55.
tasks.acceptance: CI passes on performant code; artificially heavy rendering causes CI to fail with FPS report.

tasks.title: Create architecture decision record (ADR) for core technology choices (WebGL2, Rapier, SparkJS)
tasks.deliverable: ADR document covering WebGL2, Rapier, and SparkJS selection rationale with alternatives considered.
tasks.acceptance: ADR follows standard template with Context, Decision, Consequences sections; merged to docs/.
